entry.author: What's On Christchurch
entry.summary: Words over water is a non-linear open video archive, celebrating the stories of Wakaroa Pigeon Bay, as told by members of the communities of Koukourārata Port Levy and Wakaroa Pigeon Bay. Following the birds crossing the headlands, their stories traverse the open waters of the Bay, passing on experiences of pre-contact history, colonisation, war service, relationships, family life, and observations of natural and domestic worlds. All recordings made in partnership with Keren Oertly and used with permission.
